# EncryptionOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent builder for configuring PDF encryption options.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new EncryptionOptions()
new EncryptionOptions(algorithm: EncryptionAlgorithm)
```

## Methods

- [`allowAccessibility`](#allowaccessibility): Allows text extraction for accessibility.
- [`allowAll`](#allowall): Grants all permissions (least restrictive, the default).
- [`allowAnnotations`](#allowannotations): Allows adding and modifying annotations and filling forms.
- [`allowAssembly`](#allowassembly): Allows document assembly (inserting, rotating and deleting pages).
- [`allowCopying`](#allowcopying): Allows copying of text and graphics from the document.
- [`allowFormFilling`](#allowformfilling): Allows filling of interactive form fields.
- [`allowModification`](#allowmodification): Allows modification of the document.
- [`allowPrinting`](#allowprinting): Allows printing of the document.
- [`build`](#build): Builds and returns the EncryptionSettings.
- [`denyAll`](#denyall): Denies all permissions (most restrictive).
- [`encryptMetadata`](#encryptmetadata): Sets whether to encrypt document metadata.
- [`withOwnerPassword`](#withownerpassword): Sets the owner password (permissions password).
- [`withPassword`](#withpassword): Sets both the user and the owner password to the same value.
- [`withPermissions`](#withpermissions): Sets the document permissions.
- [`withUserPassword`](#withuserpassword): Sets the user password (open password).
